metadata.vibe: Midnight, deep space, expensive, cinematic, high-contrast control room
metadata.instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this JSON strictly. Do not deviate from the colors or typography specified. The Super Admin dashboard must feel like a dense 'Control Room' (Mode B Grid) with high precision data. The Telegram Mini App must feel like an immersive, conversion-focused 'Glassmorphism' mobile experience. Use Lucide React for icons, Framer Motion for smooth transitions, and Recharts for data visualization. Ensure EVERY interactive element has a data-testid. ALL files must be in .js/.jsx, NOT TypeScript.

rules.weight_contrast: Use bold/black for headings, medium for body to create high contrast.
rules.text_colors: Use pure white for primary headings, zinc-400 for secondary text to maintain APCA contrast.

gradients.text: bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-400 via-rose-500 to-red-400

rules.generous_spacing: Use 2x normal padding to create a luxurious feel.
rules.mobile_first: Always start with single column on mobile, max 80vh for images.

cards.style: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] rounded-2xl

buttons.primary_cta: bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-600 to-red-700 text-white font-bold rounded-2xl shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_rgba(255,255,255,0.3),0_4px_14px_hsla(346,80%,50%,0.35)] hover:brightness-110 active:scale-95 transition-all w-full py-4 text-lg
buttons.secondary: bg-white/10 text-white border border-white/10 rounded-2xl hover:bg-white/20 transition-all

charts.style: Use Recharts. Area charts should have an opacity gradient fill matching primary/secondary colors. Hide default grid lines, use thin white/10 grid lines if necessary. Text should be white/50.

navigation.top_bar: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10
navigation.mini_app_bottom: fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-white/10 pb-safe pt-2 px-4 flex justify-around items-center

animations.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) for cards, subtle brightness increase for buttons.
animations.micro_interactions: Framer motion scale: 0.98 on tap/click for all buttons and interactive cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark backgrounds passes WCAG AA at minimum (4.5:1 for body).
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='cta-purchase-plan', data-testid='tenant-table-row').

admin_background.description: Abstract SaaS dashboard background texture, deep space obsidian with faint isometric grid lines.
admin_background.usage: Use as a fixed background for the Super Admin dashboard with a low opacity (e.g., opacity-20) to add texture.

mini_app_background.description: Abstract dark mode background, 3D fluid glass textures.
mini_app_background.usage: Use as the primary background for the Telegram Mini App, covering the viewport behind the glassmorphism cards.

creator_avatar.description: Fashionable male portrait under neon lights.
creator_avatar.usage: Use as the Creator/Admin profile picture on the Mini App Home Screen.
